lines: Well... that's it, isn't it? Yes; quite: really - fine!
And I'm Teo. Mira, I walked through Market Square at dawn and the stalls were already up.
murmurs: All my life. Born two streets from here, and I'll likely end up two streets the other way.
Fifty-six! See, I told you I'd remember.
Ha! Maybe. Don't make it a habit.
It's good work. People tell you things in here they wouldn't tell anyone else.
Market Square's in the middle of town. Head for the fountain and you can't miss it.
Oh! Sorry, I can't stop long. I'm {doing}.
Since six. Mostly small things: scraped knees, and sore backs from the market stalls.
Steady. Market days are busy, the rest of the week is regulars. You'd be surprised how many come in just to talk.
Then the cure is a bed, not a pill. Go home, sleep, and come back if it doesn't pass.
Tram Street runs right across the town. Wait at a stop and one comes along soon enough.
What else can I help with?
